# Weft 1.0.60
- Compare checks against the pull request's real base, including stacked branches, so changes inherited from a parent PR do not trigger false broader-verification failures. - Refresh and revalidate the comparison base before accepting a result. Missing or ambiguous PR bases are reported as check-runner issues rather than silently falling back to main. - Run approved broader verification profiles automatically when needed, or explicitly with `weft check run --scope project`. Broader commands still require project approval. - Report runner and setup blockers separately from source-code failures. These blockers no longer request code-repair handoffs. - Reuse an existing repair handoff and acknowledgement for identical failures across commits. A passing revision ends the group so a later regression can notify again. - Distinguish a repository operation in progress from another task's workspace claim. Accept all documented recovery-flag forms while preserving human approval for claim recovery. - Keep related tests in their owning packages, including configured package working directories, with expanded regression coverage.
Existing Beta features remain off by default in **Settings → Preview → Beta features**. This update preserves existing projects, worktrees, approvals and connections.
Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple silicon. Versions through 1.0.52 require one manual installation to enable in-app updates.
